documentPreference: Stable technical PDFs, manuals, process descriptions, datasheets and investor filings were preferred. Where only a product overview existed, it was accepted if it named product families and the processes they perform, and refused where it carried only adjectives.

inspected.title: Products
inspected.exactLocator: Overview and One platform, multiple tools sections
inspected.observedContent: The page names the Purion platform and its variants: Purion H high current, medium energy, Purion M mid current, Purion XE high energy, and GSD Ovation. It states that all Purion implanters share a common platform with three beamline technologies, and that the platform delivers throughput of up to 500 wafers per hour.
inspected.establishes: That Axcelis publishes a single ion-implantation platform, Purion, in high-current, mid-current, medium-energy and high-energy variants sharing a common architecture with three beamline technologies, and that Axcelis states a throughput figure of up to 500 wafers per hour for it.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The throughput figure is the company's own published number, not a measured or independently verified one. The page carries no yield, reliability or availability data, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date, so it cannot establish current product availability or that any figure was achieved in production.

inspected.title: Products
inspected.observedContent: The page names dicing saws, laser saws, grinders, polishers, wafer mounters, inspection systems, die separators, surface planers and waterjet saws, and describes the company's processing categories as cutting, grinding and polishing.
inspected.establishes: That DISCO publishes equipment lines for dicing, laser dicing, grinding, polishing, wafer mounting, inspection, die separation, surface planing and waterjet cutting, organised around cutting, grinding and polishing processes.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no throughput, yield or reliability figures, no comparison with any other supplier, and no publication date. It establishes what DISCO lists, not how any machine performs or whether any line is currently available.

inspected.title: Products
inspected.publishedOrVersion: undated page; copyright notice reads 1995 to 2026
inspected.observedContent: The page names the V93000 EXA Scale for system-on-chip test, the T5801 for memory test covering DRAM including GDDR7, LPDDR6 and DDR6, the T2000 AiR2X for system-on-chip and power analog test, and MTe for power semiconductor test.
inspected.establishes: That Advantest publishes four named automatic test system families and states which device classes each is intended to test, including the named memory standards for the T5801.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no measured throughput, no yield or reliability data and no comparison with any other supplier. It is undated, so it cannot establish current availability. Its promotional wording about precision and leadership is not a documented capability and is excluded here.

inspected.title: Products
inspected.observedContent: The page organises offerings into deposition, etch, strip and clean, mass metrology and panel processing, and names advanced packaging, cryogenic etching, metallization, DRAM, Aether, Dextro cobots and Semiverse Solutions among its categories.
inspected.establishes: That Lam Research publishes equipment and solution categories spanning deposition, etch, strip and clean, mass metrology and panel processing, and names cryogenic etching and metallization among them.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The inspected page is a navigation hub. It carries no process parameters, no performance or yield data and no comparison with any other supplier, and it is undated, so it cannot establish current product availability and says nothing about how any tool performs.

inspected.title: Products
inspected.observedContent: The page states that a silicon wafer is a thin round disk cut from high-purity silicon and that nearly all electronic equipment uses semiconductor devices. It names no product line, no wafer diameter and no specification.
inspected.establishes: Nothing specific to SUMCO. The content is a general description of what a silicon wafer is, which any source could state.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: It documents no SUMCO product line, diameter, grade or specification, and gives no quality, yield or reliability data. A generic definition of a wafer is not documentation of this company's offering.

inspected.title: Semiconductor IP
inspected.observedContent: The page groups its IP into interface IP naming PCIe, CXL, DDR, DisplayPort, Ethernet, ESUN, HBM, HDMI, MIPI, USB and UALink; foundation IP naming logic libraries, SRAM memory compilers, IO libraries, non-volatile memory, MRAM and RRAM and TCAM; SoC infrastructure naming AMBA, foundation cores, verification IP and SLM IP; security IP naming root of trust, cryptography, physical unclonable functions and hardware security modules; and IP subsystems.
inspected.establishes: That Synopsys publishes five IP categories and the specific protocols and block types it offers under each, including the named interface protocols and the named foundation memory and library types.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The page carries no benchmark, no silicon results, no yield or reliability data and no third-party validation. It is undated, so it cannot establish current product availability, and its claims about portfolio breadth and area-power-performance are promotional rather than documented capability.

inspected.title: Enable electronics processing: Product selection guide
inspected.exactLocator: Catalogue page 2; Products for electronic applications table page 3; Dow Industrial Solutions offering in electronic processing diagram page 3
inspected.observedContent: The catalogue lists semiconductor materials as photoresist, thinner, photoresist remover, wafer cutting fluid and chemical mechanical planarization, with separate display and printed circuit board listings. The products table names six families: amines including MEA, DEA, MIPA, NMEA, MDEA, AEEA, EDA and DETA; solvents including DOWANOL P-series and CARBITOL E-series glycol ethers and UCAR Ester EEP; surfactants including TRITON, TERGITOL, ECOSURF and DOWFAX; chelants including VERSENE, VERSENEX and VERSENOL; polyglycols including UCON lubricants and CARBOWAX PEGs; and ACUMER acrylic copolymers. A process diagram maps these classes onto the semiconductor flow from ingot cutting through CMP, photoresist coating, photolithography, etching and stripping.
inspected.establishes: That Dow publishes named chemical product families under the ELECPURE portfolio and maps each class onto specific semiconductor, display and printed circuit board process steps, including which classes it supplies for CMP slurry, photoresist coating, etching and stripping.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: A product selection guide. It gives no purity specification, no measured process result, no yield or reliability data and no comparison with any other supplier. It carries no publication date, so it cannot establish current product availability.
superlativesExcluded: one of the broadest technology sets in the industry

inspected.title: Logic Technology
inspected.publishedOrVersion: undated page; copyright notice reads 2010 to 2026
inspected.observedContent: The page names advanced nodes A12, A14, A16, N2, N3, N5 and N7 and mature nodes from 16nm through 0.18 micrometre. It describes A12 as a second generation backside power rail solution with a nanosheet transistor, and states years in which TSMC says it moved N3 and N5 into production.
inspected.establishes: That TSMC publishes a logic node portfolio spanning A12 through 0.18 micrometre, and describes A12 as combining a second-generation backside power rail with a nanosheet transistor.
inspected.doesNotEstablish: The page gives no yield, no defect density and no independently verified performance figure. Its statements about being the first foundry to reach a node are industry-position claims that a company cannot establish about itself and are excluded here. It is undated, so it cannot establish current availability of any node.
superlativesExcluded: first foundry to move 3nm into high-volume production
first foundry to move 5nm into volume production
